UnknownInteractionEvent.note: Fallback variant of InteractionEvent for unrecognized SSE event_type values; preserves raw JSON so an undocumented event type cannot break the stream.

UnknownResponseFormat.note: Catch-all variant of ResponseFormat for the spec's open `{ "type": object }` member and forward-compatibility; preserves raw JSON.

UnknownStep.note: Fallback variant of InteractionStep for unrecognized step `type` values; preserves raw JSON so an undocumented step type cannot break parsing of a steps list or a streamed step.start event.

UnknownStepDelta.note: Dart-only fallback variant of StepDeltaData. The API streams tool-call/result payloads (e.g. google_search_call, url_context_result) as step.delta events whose type mirrors the step but which are not in the published StepDeltaData schema; this preserves their raw JSON instead of failing the stream and keeps parsing forward-compatible.
